propPlay.writeup:
Tiffany Hayes has cleared 5+ points in 83% of her 46 games this season, and is riding a 20-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 100% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 9.3 points on the season (12.2 across her last 5) — the 5+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -550 at Fanatics.

Pauline Astier has cleared 2+ assists in 88% of her 48 games this season, and is riding a 9-game streak of doing it. She's hitting 90% over her last 10 and 100% over her last 5, averaging 3.4 assists on the season (3.4 across her last 5) — the 2+ line sits well below her normal output. Priced -560 at BetRivers.

Two legs from two different games at a combined -255 — each leg stands on its own record, and neither result can drag the other down.
